method: KiCad exported netlist + bounded DC calculations; simulation reported separately; no physical test
isolation_topology: PASS: controller and ten host domains remain separate through defined barriers
local_indicators: 20 driver LEDs + 3V3 + active-low output-enable; existing RJ45 LINK/ACT; not physical contact feedback
control_only_topology: PASS: 20 dry contacts, no LED sensing/supplies, ten separate host ESD references
timer_note: MC14541B single-transition, AR=1, MR high default, QSEL=1, A=B=1. 200k/1nF C0G, Rs=400k. ARM gates the output independently. Clock tolerance/model and physical qualification are reported separately.

spice_simulation.method: ngspice datasheet-fitted aggregate counter and transistor/photorelay behavioral models
limitations: Clock aggregated using datasheet RC equation; physical oscillator and exact IC behavior are not vendor modeled.
Bench-qualify timeout over power and operating temperature before manufacturing release.
Repeated ARM low/high transitions start new windows; not a safety-rated anti-malicious-firmware interlock.
USB/Ethernet SI, ESD, EMC, load transients and PCB behavior not covered.
